name: Redirect Review
description: Report on redirects created by the Redirect module.
project_description:
This module is used to provide an overview of redirects that have issues. Redirects created over a period of time get ignored. If there are 100's of redirects created, there is no way of knowing which redirect is still working as it was intended to be when it was created. This module provides an interface where you can see the list of redirects that have issues like 403, 404 & Redirect loop. The user then takes action manually by either editing the redirect to point to the right page or deleting them altogether. 

 Use "Redirect Audit" module instead.
